_doc: Explicit per-(card,sink) whitelist of golds permitted to carry a free-text residual sink. STATELESS INVARIANT: any gold x sink NOT listed here must be free-text-free, else loud failure (DestringSinkRatchetTests -> renamed FreeTextWhitelistTests). Each entry is a NAMED carve-out: tag 'debt' = slated for a burndown slice (see libs/magic-ast/docs/gold-burndown-plan.md); tag 'irreducible' = permanent, no structured representation. A listed (card,sink) that no longer carries the sink also fails (remove it). Replaces the opaque aggregate count baseline destring-sink-baseline.json (de-ratcheted 2026-06-16).

entries.reason: PB-9 LoseAbilityEffect residual — 'enchant creature card in a graveyard' names a SPECIFIC printed ability verbatim, not an unbounded scope; distinct from StopCold/VraskaBetrayalsSting's 'all'/'all other' determiner, which now has a structured LoseAbilityEffect.Scope (AbilityScope.All/AllOther, ADR 0004 #40 wave-2) — that field doesn't apply here since there is no enum value for 'this exact named ability'

compound cast-history gate ('cast from your hand AND cast another named spell this game') — two novel condition shapes (CastFromZoneCondition + NamedSpellCastHistoryCondition) with no recurring peer; PB-7 structured-condition buckets

PB-7 structured-condition buckets — upkeep intervening-if 'you had another creature enter the battlefield under your control last turn' is a last-turn history predicate with no structured node yet (line 3; out of scope for the devotion-gated status family targeting line 2)
PB-7 structured-condition buckets (entangled: reference-not-resolution engine contract)

RESIDUAL NARROWED (ADR 0004 #40 wave-3): the attack-trigger reanimation ('put target creature card from defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking') is now structured (ReturnToBattlefieldEffect with the new Attacking bool + Controller=DefendingPlayer). The remaining UnstructuredEffect is the Void end-step 'sacrifice this Aura unless a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn' — a compound unless-condition (PB-7 structured-condition buckets, sibling ConditionParser territory), not an effect-grammar gap

PB-7 structured-condition buckets (entangled: reference-not-resolution engine contract) — Prowl's CR 702.76a intervening-if ('a player was dealt combat damage this turn by a source ... that ... had any of the creature types of this spell') is the same reference-not-resolution residual as its Freerunning/Spectacle/Surge alt-cast-condition siblings

WAVE-4 COMPOSITE (ADR 0004 #40 wave-3, analyzed not forced): the three leaf nodes exist (SearchLibraryEffect, CastWithoutPayingEffect, ShuffleEffect) but a faithful 'Search target opponent's library for an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then that player shuffles.' composite is blocked on two cross-cutting gaps: (1) SearchLibraryEffect.Destination is required and has no value for 'found-but-not-relocated, cast from the library' — the search moves the card to no zone; (2) 'target opponent's library' needs a whose-library targeting axis on the search Filter (ObjectFilter/reference territory, sibling-owned; no existing exemplar for search-opponent-library). Forcing it would be lossy (wrong Destination) or make unilateral ObjectFilter decisions outside this slice — held for a dedicated wave-4 slice coordinated with the ObjectFilter owner

PB-7 structured-condition buckets — 'it wasn't put onto the battlefield with this ability' is a loop-prevention anti-recursion gate unique to Kodama of the East Tree; requires a new NotEnteredByAbilityCondition arm with no current peer

BLOCKED ON CONDITION SLICE (ADR 0004 #40 wave-3): the effect half 'you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost' is structurable (MayPlayFromExileEffect over Cards={Zone:Exile, ExiledWith:Self}, plus a WithoutPayingManaCost adjunct), but the trailing gate 'if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn' is a COUNT-gated attack-history condition with no structured node (YouAttackedThisTurnCondition is the field-less Raid yes/no, not a >=N attacker count) — sibling ConditionParser territory. Structuring the effect alone would relocate the sink UnstructuredEffect->OtherCondition without reducing debt, so held whole pending a coordinated condition slice
